record_hint: Use the MCP tools fpga_record_decision, fpga_record_impression, fpga_record_vision_review, fpga_record_reconcile, fpga_record_read, fpga_record_insight and fpga_record_song_receipt (or `python -m fpga record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with fpga_records_search / fpga_records_digest.
